scheme_name: SSP Post-Matric Scholarship for UG Degree & Diploma Students (State Scholarship Portal)
authority: Social Welfare, Backward Classes Welfare & Higher Education Depts (State Portals)
benefit: 100% College Tuition Fee Waiver / Concession + Vidyasiri Monthly Maintenance Stipend (₹1,500/month or up to ₹15,000/yr)

criteria.label: Enrollment in post-secondary Under-Graduate (UG) degree / diploma program
criteria.plain_description: Student must be actively admitted to a recognized undergraduate degree (BA, BSc, BCom, BTech, MBBS, BCA, BBA) or polytechnic diploma course.
criteria.source_clause: SSP Post-Matric Scheme Operational Manual Section 2.1 - Recognized Courses
criteria.remediation: Upload college admission receipt or student identity card with registration number.

criteria.label: Annual household family income limit (<= ₹2,50,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total annual income of student's parents/guardian must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
criteria.source_clause: SSP Guidelines Section 3 - Income Verification via Revenue Database
criteria.remediation: Upload digital Income Certificate (RD certificate) showing family income <= ₹2.5 Lakh/yr.

criteria.label: Social category or economic/rural welfare eligibility
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must belong to SC, ST, OBC (Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B), EWS, or economically weaker rural household.
criteria.source_clause: SSP Guidelines Section 4 - Target Community Classification
criteria.remediation: Provide State Caste / Category Certificate or digital RD-numbered certificate.

criteria.label: Aadhaar consent and NPCI active bank account mapping
criteria.plain_description: Student's Aadhaar must be linked to bank account and active on NPCI DBT mapper.
criteria.source_clause: SSP Operational Guidelines Section 5 - Direct Bank Disbursal via Aadhaar
criteria.remediation: Verify that student Aadhaar is linked to bank account on NPCI portal.

application.office_name: District Social Welfare / Taluk Backward Classes Welfare Office
documents_to_carry: College Admission / Fee Receipt with Student Registration Number (USN / Reg No)
Aadhaar Card and Seeded Bank Passbook
Hostel Stay Certificate (for Vidyasiri / Food stipend if applicable)
process_steps: Create student account on State Scholarship Portal (SSP) using Aadhaar and e-Attestation
Get academic documents e-attested by designated college e-Attestation Officer
Submit Post-Matric UG Scholarship application selecting your college and university registration number
College verifies fee structure and attendance online
Welfare Department sanctions tuition fee waiver and maintenance stipend directly via DBT
